// re-running export will overwrite. Source: /tmp/spec.yml
// Intent: cover every commonly exported step and outcome shape
// Lang: ts

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("golden_kitchen_sink", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets; bounded to 30m–4h.
  test.setTimeout(1800000);

  const requests: Array<{ url: string; method: string; status?: number }> = [];
  page.on("response", (r) => requests.push({ url: r.url(), method: r.request().method(), status: r.status() }));

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/app");
  // step: wait_text
  await page.waitForFunction("String(document.body?.innerText ?? \"\").replace(/\\s+/g, \" \").trim().toLowerCase().includes(\"welcome\")", undefined, { timeout: 5000 });
  // when: text:Accept cookies
  if (await page.evaluate(() => String(document.body?.innerText ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes("accept cookies"))) {
    // step: maybe_dismiss
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept" }).first().click();
  }
  // step: hover_row
  await page.locator(".row").hover();
  // step: fill_name
  {
    for (let fillAttempt = 0; ; fillAttempt++) {
      await page.getByLabel("Name").first().fill("Ada");
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      try {
        await expect(page.getByLabel("Name").first()).toHaveValue("Ada", { timeout: 500 });
        break;
      } catch (err) {
        if (fillAttempt >= 3) throw new Error("hydration wiped value after 4 attempts", { cause: err });
      }
    }
  }
  // step: pick
  await page.locator("#plan").selectOption({ value: "pro" });
  // step: press_enter
  await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  // step: scroll_down
  await page.mouse.wheel(0, 300);
  // step: eval_probe
  const title = await page.evaluate(async (args) => {
    return document.title;
  }, {});
  // Note: later steps that splice ${evals.title…} are not rewritten — wire variables manually if needed.

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // greets: greeting is visible
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Hello", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });

  // on_dashboard: landed on the dashboard
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp("^https://example\\.com/dash"));

  // rows_present: at least 3 rows
  expect(await page.locator(".row").count()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);

  // api_ok: list API succeeded
  expect(requests.some((r) => r.url.includes("/api/list") && (r.status ?? 0) < 400)).toBe(true);

});
